measurement_basis.observation_character: FACT: single bounded observation on the build Mac; the inventory states these timings are not universal performance claims

scope.budget_unit: one document run: intake -> preflight -> extract -> plan -> apply -> verify -> dispose
scope.isolation: one expendable worker process per document; private per-run temp; no cross-document state (INV-11)
scope.inputs_covered: the 14 sealed fixtures (F01-F08, R01-R04, B01-B02), lane 03 mutants M01-M06, and harness-synthetic trip probes; nothing else
scope.not_a_claim: synthetic local vertical slice only; no production-service or arbitrary-PDF safety claim

gate_mapping.related: lane 02 G09_INDEPENDENT_RENDER_INK corresponds to lane 01/03 G10 and consumes frozen_constants.render_dpi
gate_mapping.fail_closed: if BUDGETS.json or a harness measurement point is unavailable, that budget is recorded NOT_EXERCISED and lane 01 G9 cannot be PASS (NOT_VERIFIABLE via PR-08 for in-scope classes)

measured_on: source page count from the intake parser
candidate page count from the independent extractor at verify; must also equal the source count (INV-02)
budgets.rationale: Any input above 8 pages is out of the sealed slice and refuses at intake; generous vs the 4-page sealed max.

measured_on: raw object inventory from the conservative parser at intake
verifier re-inventory consumed by lane 01 gates G1/G2

baseline.basis: no object counts appear in ENVIRONMENT-INVENTORY.md

budgets.derivation: INFERENCE: a classic xref spends at least ~20 bytes per object, so the largest sealed fixture (6969 bytes) mechanically cannot exceed ~348 objects; 1000 is ~2.9x that ceiling
budgets.rationale: Fail-closed conservative bound; the first pipeline run must record the actual per-fixture object counts.

measured_on: byte size of the source at intake, before parse; must equal the sealed manifest byte_size and sha256 (INV-01)
budgets.rationale: Matches the lane 03 frozen ceiling that every sealed PDF is under 200 KB (GENERATOR-SPEC.md section 5).

measured_on: sum of width*height over every page rendered during the run (source render set + candidate render set) at frozen 150 DPI
cross-checked against actual PNG dimensions via installed Pillow; both values recorded

baseline.basis: derived: 2 renders x 4 pages x 2103750 px/page (US Letter at 150 DPI = 1275x1650)

budgets.rationale: Defensive backstop; unreachable while PAGE_COUNT <= 8 and render_dpi = 150 hold; catches renderer-parameter drift or repeated render loops.

measured_on: children (poppler): resource.getrusage(RUSAGE_CHILDREN) delta over waited-for subprocesses
harness-owned; never builder self-report (lane 01 G9 independence)
budgets.derivation: INFERENCE: observed wall component sum is ~10 s worst case; assuming CPU ~ wall for single-threaded poppler, 600 cpu-seconds is at least ~60x
budgets.rationale: Hard stop for runaway workers on a synthetic slice; first run records actuals.

measured_on: time.monotonic() delta across the whole run, harness-owned, never builder self-report

baseline.basis: derived from observed components: 0.04 s (pdftotext, F01) + 2 x 4.96 s (source and candidate pdftoppm -r 150 at the observed F01 rate)

budgets.rationale: Generous bound that still guarantees termination of a stalled stage.

measured_on: sum of file sizes under the private per-run temp directory, sampled at every stage boundary and at any trip; maximum recorded

baseline.basis: derived worst need: source render set (<= 461550 B) + candidate render set (<= 2x) + candidate PDF (~source scale) + extraction text + CDRR

budgets.rationale: Prevents disk exhaustion; frozen sampling cadence keeps the check mechanical.

measured_on: size of the finished candidate PDF at write time, before atomic rename

baseline.basis: no candidate exists yet; no builder has run in this experiment

budgets.derivation: INFERENCE: expected candidate magnitude is source scale (under ~10 KiB including added outline/structure tags); 1 MiB is a ~100x tripwire, not a target
budgets.rationale: A candidate orders of magnitude larger than its source signals a defect; trip and refuse.

frozen_constants.atomic_write_procedure: write to '<final_name>.tmp-<run_id>' in the final target directory, fsync, then os.replace to the final name
frozen_constants.budget_rollover: all eight budget ids roll up into lane 01 gate G9 / lane 02 gate G11_RESOURCE_BUDGET_NO_NETWORK; status semantics in status_mapping

status_mapping.WITHIN_BUDGET: measured value exists and satisfies '<= limit'
status_mapping.EXCEEDED: measured value exists and violates the limit; trip or post-hoc G9/G11 FAIL per SAFETY-SPEC section 5
status_mapping.NOT_EXERCISED: measurement point never ran (refused earlier, out of scope) or harness/BUDGETS.json unavailable; observed=null; never counts as PASS (INV-08)
status_mapping.ERROR: the measurement itself failed; treated as gate ERROR, worse than FAIL (lane 01 section 5)

not_measured_disclosures: OBJECT_COUNT: no per-fixture object counts exist in the packet; the first pipeline run must record them (UNKNOWN preserved).
CPU_SECONDS: the inventory contains wall times only; the CPU baseline is UNKNOWN until the first run.
OUTPUT_BYTES: no builder output exists in the packet; the first candidate size is UNKNOWN until lanes 08/09 run.

Tool-version tension (FACT, unresolved here): ENVIRONMENT-INVENTORY.md observes Python 3.12.14 / reportlab 4.4.9 / pypdf 6.10.0, while FIXTURE-MANIFEST.json records sealing with Python 3.12.7 / reportlab 5.0.1 / pypdf 6.14.2. Budgets are sized to file/page/pixel magnitudes, not tool speed; Gate A and lane 06 must record actual run-time versions and adjudicate.

experiment_level_informational.note: harness bookkeeping only; not a receipt budget id and never written into receipts budgets arrays
